insight: Spun out of gaming-clips startup Medal in October 2024 with $10M in funding led by General Catalyst.
name: Highlight AI
tagline: A desktop AI assistant that sees your screen and works across every app.
description: Highlight AI is a desktop assistant that reads on-screen context across the apps you use, so you can ask about and act on whatever you're looking at without copying it into a chat box. It captures screen content, voice, and documents to answer questions, summarize, and transcribe meetings locally. A free tier offers unlimited chat with auto-selected base models; Pro unlocks premium frontier models and cloud transcription.

modelSupport.notes: Auto-selects base models for free chats; Pro adds premium frontier models.

edge: Grounds answers in your live on-screen context across every app, so you query what you're looking at without copy-paste into a chat window.
pros: Reads on-screen context across all apps
Free tier with unlimited base-model chat
cons: Premium models gated to Pro credits
